events.text: Bingolotto premiered nationwide on TV4 with Leif Loket Olsson as show host.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 19 October 1991 , Bingolotto premiered nationwide on TV4 with the popular Leif Loket Olsson as show host .

events.text: Bingolotto had raised viewing figures from 1.3 million viewers to 2.1 million viewers.
events.subject: self
events.quote: From October 1991 to March 1992 , Bingolotto had raised viewing figures from 1.3 million viewers to 2.1 million viewers .

events.text: Bingolotto's rise in viewing figures from 1.3 million to 2.1 million viewers ended.
